name: dev.tryfrisk/frisk
title: Frisk
description: Screen the counterparty of an x402 payment before an agent pays it. Runs offline by default.

environmentVariables.name: FRISK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hosted API key. Without it the server screens entirely offline.

environmentVariables.name: FRISK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the hosted endpoint. Defaults to https://api.tryfrisk.dev.
